subject: Trailhead Labs - telemetry extract definition, upload window, and legal questions
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Chris Nguyen <chris@trailheadlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Trailhead - telemetry extracts and intake window (pre-call materials attached)

Hi Chris —

Thanks for taking time to run through the SIG/telemetry ingest questions on Monday. To make the call productive, can you confirm the following ahead of the intake?

1) Data window: we typically request a 7-day sliding telemetry sample plus one business-day of recent logs for timezone-aware checks. Does that work for you, or do you need specific calendar dates?
2) PII/hashed fields: the attached spec lists columns we expect (ip_address_hashed, request_path, model_id, session_id_ts). If you have field names that differ, send a mapping.
3) Upload method: we can accept S3 presigned PUTs or an SFTP drop. If S3, we'll provide a presigned bucket and short-lived creds.

Attached: redwood_extract_spec.csv (sample rows + required field types), sig-field-mapping.xlsx (template).

Proposed pre-call slots (PST):
- Mon 2026-04-12 09:00–09:30
- Mon 2026-04-12 13:00–13:30
- Tue 2026-04-13 10:00–10:30

If none work, tell me what does and we'll coordinate. Also looping in Marissa (security intake) and David (observability) to surface any redlines.

Thanks,
Naomi
Sr. Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_extract_spec.csv (CSV, 6KB)]
[Attachment: sig-field-mapping.xlsx (XLSX, 18KB)]

From: Chris Nguyen <chris@trailheadlabs.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@trailheadlabs.com>, support@trailheadlabs.com
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trailhead - telemetry extracts and intake window (pre-call materials attached)

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for the note and attachments. A few quick clarifications from our side before the call:

• Window dates: we can provide April 1–7 as the 7-day sample and April 8 as the most-recent day.
• Fields: our column names are slightly different (client_ip, path, model_name, session_ts). I'll attach a CSV mapping in the next email.
• PII: we cannot share any unhashed client identifiers. We can provide SHA256-hashed IPs; is that acceptable?
• Retention question from Legal: Maria (cc'd) asked whether Redwood will retain the sample after testing or whether we should expect deletion by you within 7 days. We also need a written note about retention policy for our procurement team.

We prefer S3 presigned upload. Can you send the bucket name and expected TTL for the presigned URLs?

Happy to take the Mon 04/12 13:00 slot if still available.

—Chris
Chris Nguyen
Director of Security & Ops, Trailhead Labs
[Attachment: trailhead_fieldnames.csv (CSV, 1KB)]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Chris Nguyen <chris@trailheadlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trailhead - telemetry extracts and intake window (pre-call materials attached)

Hi Chris / Maria —

Confirmed: 04/12 13:00 PST works; invite sent.

Quick answers to the raised points so you have them in writing before Legal reviews:
• Retention: Redwood requests the sample for diagnostics and QA. Our default handling for short-term samples is automated deletion after 7 calendar days from ingest unless an explicit exception is requested by the customer. We will not keep any raw telemetry in production buckets beyond that window unless you ask us to. We'll provide a short retention statement for Maria to include in procurement.
• Hashing: SHA256-hashed client identifiers are fine — please indicate in the mapping file which fields are hashed.
• Presigned URLs: we'll provide an S3 presign endpoint with 24-hour TTL on the presigned PUTs and a one-time upload token. We'll send the presigned instructions in a follow-up email labeled "Upload Runbook."

Action items (internal owners):
- Marissa: draft the 1-paragraph retention statement and procurement-friendly wording (due 2026-04-12 11:30 PST).
- David: validate that the sample fields as mapped will allow our sequence/replay tests (due 2026-04-12 11:45 PST).
- Marcus: prepare the S3 bucket/presign coordination and include expected TTL and small runbook (due 2026-04-12 12:30 PST).

Attachments going to Trailhead after this message: upload-runbook.md (S3 presign steps), and I'll include our retention blurb.

See you on the call.

Naomi
Sr. Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: upload-runbook.md (Markdown, 2KB)]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Internal prep: Trailhead call recap + who speaks to what (pre-call)

Team —

Recap from the intake thread & quick prep before the 13:00 PST call:

Summary: Trailhead will provide April 1–7 sample + April 8 recent day. They will hash PII fields (SHA256). They want written confirmation of deletion after 7 days. They will upload via S3 presigned PUTs.

Who speaks to what:
- Marissa: retention language and procurement note (I'll introduce you at the start of the call).
- David: explain the minimal required columns to run the replay tests and what to do if session_ts precision is low.
- Marcus: walk through the S3 presign flow and confirm TTL and access logs.

Prep notes:
- Keep answers high-level; don't promise storage beyond the 7-day window without a customer request.
- If Trailhead asks about SOC 2 attestations for the sample handling process, reference our SOC 2 controls but defer detailed legal questions to security-compliance@redwood.ai.

I'll bring the upload runbook and the mapping file to the call.

Naomi
